newsitem.title: USA: Cole sees FY97 eps in range $1.60-$1.64.
newsitem.headline: Cole sees FY97 eps in range $1.60-$1.64.

text.p: Cole National Corp said on Wednesday it expects its fiscal year 1997 earnings to be in the range of $1.60 per share and $1.64 per share, in line with analysts' estimates.
These estimates are before one-time charges and the interest expense associated with the $150 million debt issued to finance the acquisition of Pearle Inc, the company said.
Cole said earnings for the fourth quarter will be "on target" despite sales that were below expectations.

"The integration of Pearle is going as planned and we believe 1997 will be another year of revenue and earnings growth. We also hope to reach or exceed $1 billion of revenue in fiscal 1997," the company said.
Cole, a vision care retailer, said comparable store sales for the four week period ended December 28, 1996, increased 3.9 per cent.

The company bought Pearle in November and has announced it expects to take a charge for business integration and consolidation costs and other non recurring charges in the range of $35 million to $45 million after tax in the fourth quarter of fiscal year 1996.
